title: Graduate Division Conference Travel Grant
eligibility: Academic master's and all doctoral students registered for the term of travel, in good standing, presenting a paper or poster (professional and self-supporting programs and filing-fee students not eligible)
benefit: Up to $900 (California), $1,400 (rest of North America), $2,300 (outside North America)
description: Grant for presenting at a professional conference or for professional development; master's students get one per career, doctoral students two. Fall grants open August 1 with a December 1 deadline; spring grants open January 2 (deadline May 1); summer grants open May 2 (deadline August 1).

title: Summer Dissertation Writing Grant (Arts & Humanities)
eligibility: Advanced-to-candidacy doctoral students in the arts, humanities, or humanistic social sciences who can write full-time for two summer months; prior recipients not eligible
description: Summer grant paired with a structured dissertation-writing group. Last cycle the deadline was March 30, 2026; the 2027 date wasn't posted yet — check the page.

title: Dolores Zohrab Liebmann Fellowship
eligibility: Enrolled UC Berkeley graduate students who are U.S. citizens with a U.S. bachelor's degree, financial need, and a strong undergraduate record
description: Need-based fellowship for humanities, social science, science, and professional students. The 2026-27 application has closed (deadline was January 5); the next cycle's materials are not posted yet — check the page.

title: Doctoral Completion Fellowship (DCF)
eligibility: Doctoral students in participating programs, advanced to candidacy before the semester begins, GPA 3.0+, satisfactory candidacy review, and at least one external fellowship application (international students exempt)
benefit: In-state tuition and a stipend for two semesters
description: Completion incentive used by eligible doctoral programs under Graduate Division policy F3.1; there is no central application deadline — ask your department about eligibility and timing.

title: Graduate Division Student Parent Grant (2026-27)
eligibility: Graduate students living with a dependent child under 18 who file a 2026-27 FAFSA with financial need; U.S. citizens, permanent residents, or AB540; not self-supporting programs
description: Need-based grant for graduate student parents. The 2026-27 application opened after July 1, 2026; no closing date is listed, and prorated grants may be given as funding permits.

title: Graduate Division Student Caregiver Grant (2026-27)
eligibility: Graduate students who live with and are primary caregiver for a qualifying dependent adult, file a 2026-27 FAFSA with financial need; not self-supporting programs
benefit: Up to $12,000 per year ($6,000 per term), as funding permits
description: Need-based grant for graduate student caregivers that can go toward housing, living costs, dependent health insurance, or tuition. The 2026-27 application opened after July 1, 2026; no closing date is listed.

title: GA Professional Development Award
eligibility: Registered full-time graduate students (or on filing fee) with advisor confirmation that the activity benefits their education or research
benefit: Up to $500 per year (PhD students twice per career, other grad students once)
description: Rolling award for professional development such as workshops, coaching, or skill-building; applications submitted by the end of the 3rd week of each month are reviewed while funds last, with a lottery if oversubscribed.

title: GA Grad Student Parent Travel Award
eligibility: Graduate student parents or guardians who must bring a child or caregiver to a conference outside the Bay Area; no presentation or advisor approval required
description: Covers childcare, child/caregiver travel, food, and car-seat rental for conference trips. The 2026-27 cycle is open with rolling review and no fixed deadline.

title: Graduate Student Instructor (GSI) appointments
eligibility: Registered graduate students enrolled in 12+ units with a 3.0+ GPA, no more than two incompletes, and satisfactory progress; not available in absentia or on filing fee
benefit: ASE salary plus partial fee remission for fall/spring appointments of 25% time or more
description: GSI (teaching) positions are selected by each department; check your department and the campus list of expected ASE job openings. There is no single campus deadline.

title: Graduate Student Researcher (GSR) appointments
eligibility: Registered graduate students enrolled in 12+ units with a 3.0+ GPA and satisfactory progress; allowed in absentia but not on filing fee
benefit: UC-UAW salary scale plus fee remission for fall/spring appointments of 25% time or more; nonresident tuition remission possible for doctoral GSRs at 45%+
description: GSRs are hired directly by faculty or principal investigators, so ask faculty and department staff about openings. There is no campus-wide application or deadline.

title: Graduate Fellowship in STEM Diversity (formerly NPSC)
eligibility: U.S. citizens on a Ph.D. track in the physical sciences and related engineering fields, with an emphasis on historically underrepresented students
benefit: $20,000 plus tuition and fees; one or two paid summer internships
description: Ph.D.-track fellowship in the physical sciences and related engineering fields. The Graduate Division lists the deadline as January 15 (no year printed on the page — check before applying).

title: Art Rosenfeld Award for Energy Efficiency
eligibility: UC Berkeley graduate students (Ph.D., master’s, J.D. or professional) committed to research on energy efficiency; undocumented students eligible
description: For technical, social science or policy research that can reduce energy use. The Graduate Division lists the deadline as February 20 (no year printed on the page — check before applying).

title: Roselyn Lindheim Award
eligibility: Continuing UC Berkeley graduate students working on community, architectural or public health environments that promote wellness
benefit: Up to $10,000 for one or two students
description: Supports work on community, architectural and public health environments and interventions. The Graduate Division lists the deadline as February 17 (no year printed on the page — check before applying).

title: Mentored Research Award
eligibility: Academic Ph.D. students nominated by their department; undocumented students eligible
description: Lets promising Ph.D. students do pre-doctoral research while building relationships with faculty advisers. Students must be nominated by their department first. The Graduate Division lists the deadline as March 2 (no year printed on the page — check before applying).

title: Georges Lurcy Fellowship for Study in France
eligibility: U.S. citizens or permanent residents (doctoral) whose research topic pertains to France and can only be pursued there
description: Funds a year of study or research in France. The Graduate Division lists the deadline as March 27 (no year printed on the page — check before applying).

title: Philip Brett LGBT Studies Fellowship
eligibility: Open to all UC Berkeley graduate students, including international students. All UC Berkeley graduate students doing research related to LGBTQ studies in any field
description: For graduate research related to lesbian, gay, bisexual, transgender and/or queer studies. The Graduate Division lists the deadline as March 13 (no year printed on the page — check before applying).

title: CEND Fellowships (Center for Emerging & Neglected Diseases)
eligibility: Graduate students working on infectious diseases that affect marginalized or underserved communities — lab, engineering, modeling or health policy
description: For research on infectious diseases affecting underserved communities. The Graduate Division lists the deadline as April 14 (no year printed on the page — check before applying).

title: Chowdhury Fellowships (Bangladesh studies)
eligibility: Open to all admitted and current Berkeley graduate students, including international students. Admitted incoming and current Berkeley graduate students whose training or research significantly involves contemporary Bangladesh (or historical work in the region)
description: For graduate work focused on Bangladesh and the region. The Graduate Division lists the deadline as April 1 (no year printed on the page — check before applying).

title: Global, International & Area Studies (GIAS) Grants
eligibility: Berkeley graduate students conducting research in international and area studies
description: Several fellowships for graduate research in international and area studies, including pre-dissertation research. The Graduate Division lists the deadline as April 1 (no year printed on the page — check before applying).

title: Gabriel Trujillo Field Work Scholarship
eligibility: Berkeley graduate students doing field work
description: Supports graduate field research; created by the Graduate Assembly in memory of Ph.D. candidate Gabriel Trujillo. The Graduate Division lists the deadline as April 12 (no year printed on the page — check before applying).

title: Luce Indigenous Knowledge Fellowship
eligibility: Graduate students furthering Indigenous knowledge creation and perpetuation in Indigenous communities
description: Henry Luce Foundation fellowship; Berkeley’s American Indian Graduate Program can help with applications. The Graduate Division lists the deadline as April 7 (no year printed on the page — check before applying).

title: Greater Good Science Center Graduate Fellowships
eligibility: UC Berkeley graduate students whose research relates to the Greater Good Science Center’s mission, especially social-behavioral sciences
description: Annual fellowships for research on well-being and prosocial behavior. The Graduate Division lists the deadline as March 20 (no year printed on the page — check before applying).

title: Paul J. Alexander Memorial Fellowship
eligibility: Advanced Berkeley graduate students studying Byzantine (first preference), ancient or medieval history
description: For graduate study in Byzantine, ancient or medieval history. The Graduate Division lists the deadline as March 20 (no year printed on the page — check before applying).

title: Jim Fahey Safe Homes for Women Fellowship
eligibility: Berkeley graduate students with financial need and a commitment to combating domestic violence against women; preference for students close to graduation
description: For graduate students working against domestic violence. The Graduate Division lists the deadline as March 6 (no year printed on the page — check before applying).

title: Bancroft Library Study Awards
eligibility: Continuing UC graduate students planning advanced research using Bancroft Library source materials
description: Research awards for work based on Bancroft Library collections; apply through the Bancroft Library. The Graduate Division lists the deadline as February 1 (no year printed on the page — check before applying).

title: Doctoral Fellowship — Berkeley Center for Private Law Theory
eligibility: Ph.D. students working on private law theory
description: For doctoral research on private law (market, workplace, property, family relations). The Graduate Division lists the deadline as February 1 (no year printed on the page — check before applying).

title: Guru Gobind Singh Fellowship
eligibility: Graduates of universities in specific areas of India and Pakistan pursuing a graduate degree at UC who plan to return home after the degree
description: For graduate students from qualifying regions of India and Pakistan. The Graduate Division lists the deadline as April 24 (no year printed on the page — check before applying).

title: Dr. and Mrs. James C.Y. Soong Fellowships
eligibility: Full-time Berkeley graduate students from Taiwan (graduates of a 4-year Taiwanese university with a 3.7+ GPA)
description: For graduate students from Taiwan in any field. The Graduate Division lists the deadline as April 3 (no year printed on the page — check before applying).
